detected_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (frames reviewed in a Claude Code session, not via API)
credits: Footage: "Drone footage of a destroyed barn in an abandoned farm" (Pexels #15439362) and "Drone footage of an abandoned farm" (Pexels #15439355), Pexels License.

frame_0001.jpg.scene: Two concrete-stave silos with metal domes beside the barn.

observations.label: Hole torn in silo dome
observations.description: A panel of the left silo's metal dome has torn open, leaving a hole at the edge of the dome.
observations.visual_evidence: Dark gap with bent sheet edges where a dome panel has come away.
observations.suggested_fix: Secure or remove loose dome panels before they blow off; if the silo stays, replace the damaged panels.

observations.label: Heavy rust on silo dome
observations.description: The right silo's dome has heavy rust streaks running down most of its panels and the coating has failed.
observations.visual_evidence: Orange rust runs between the ribs across the whole dome, bare metal showing.
observations.suggested_fix: Check the dome for thinned or holed panels and loose fasteners; recoat or replace.

observations.label: Vines covering silos
observations.description: Vines have grown up the sides of both silos to the domes.
observations.visual_evidence: Dense brown vine growth up the stave walls.
observations.suggested_fix: Cut the vines at the base, let them die back, then remove them and inspect the stave walls and hoops underneath.

frame_0002.jpg.scene: Looking down on a silo dome with the damaged barn and sheds behind; a roofless brick silo in the field.

observations.label: Rusted silo dome with open top hatch
observations.description: This dome is heavily rusted and its top hatch is open or missing, letting rain straight into the silo.
observations.visual_evidence: Rust-red dome with a black circular opening at the top.
observations.suggested_fix: Close or cap the hatch; inspect and recoat or replace the dome.

observations.label: Barn roof partly collapsed
observations.component: main barn roof beside the silos
observations.description: The barn roof next to the silos is broken up, with sheets torn loose and sections fallen in.
observations.visual_evidence: Buckled and missing roof sheets, exposed framing and debris on the roof.
observations.extent: Large part of the barn roof
observations.suggested_fix: Keep everyone out of the barn; a structural engineer should decide whether it can be stabilised or must be demolished.

frame_0003.jpg.scene: Overhead view of the collapsed sheds, a parked car, and the roofless brick silo.

observations.label: Collapsed shed roofs
observations.description: Several open-sided sheds have partly collapsed: roof panels have dropped, separated or are lying on the ground.
observations.visual_evidence: Rusted red roof sheets at broken angles and gaps between sections, with debris beneath.
observations.suggested_fix: Demolish the collapsed sheds or brace them before anyone goes under them; collect the loose sheets.

observations.label: Roofless brick silo leaning
observations.component: free-standing brick silo in the field
observations.description: A roofless brick silo stands on its own in the field and appears to lean.
observations.visual_evidence: Tall brick cylinder with no top, visibly off vertical against the ground.
observations.suggested_fix: Fence off a fall zone of at least the silo's height, keep everyone away, and get a structural engineer to decide on emergency bracing or controlled demolition.

frame_0004.jpg.scene: Close pass over a collapsed shed; brick silo in the background; metal sheets in the grass.

observations.label: Collapsed shed roof lying on the ground
observations.description: This shed's roof has dropped at one end and rests on the ground at an angle.
observations.visual_evidence: Red roof panel sloping from its posts down to the ground; posts leaning.
observations.suggested_fix: Demolish or prop the shed; keep people and vehicles from under it.

observations.label: Loose metal sheets lying in the field
observations.description: Loose metal roofing sheets are lying in the grass. Strong wind can throw them.
observations.visual_evidence: Grey sheet metal pieces on the ground away from any structure.
observations.suggested_fix: Collect and stack or remove the loose sheets.

frame_0005.jpg.scene: Farm from ground level: barn and silos with damaged roofs, sheds and a wood pile.

observations.label: Barn roof sagging with missing roofing
observations.description: The barn's roof sags along the ridge and some roofing is missing.
observations.visual_evidence: Uneven ridge line and dark gaps in the roof covering.
observations.suggested_fix: Keep people out; structural assessment of the roof framing.

frame_0007.jpg.scene: Looking down on the barn roof and silo domes.

observations.label: Barn roof with many holes and missing sheets
observations.description: From above, the barn roof has many holes where sheets are missing, and roofing is torn and folded back.
observations.visual_evidence: Dark openings across the rusted roof, sheets peeled back.
observations.extent: Most of the roof in view
observations.suggested_fix: Structural assessment; if kept, re-roof after the frame is repaired.

frame_0008.jpg.scene: Low pass over collapsed shed roofing; the brick silo and a power pole with transformer in the field.

observations.label: Roofless brick silo leaning
observations.component: free-standing brick silo in the field
observations.description: The roofless brick silo is clearly leaning off vertical.
observations.visual_evidence: Brick cylinder visibly tilted relative to the level ground and fence line.
observations.suggested_fix: Fence off a fall zone of at least the silo's height, keep everyone away, and get a structural engineer to decide on emergency bracing or controlled demolition.

observations.label: Rusted and torn roofing on collapsed sheds
observations.description: The shed roofing is heavily rusted, and the sheets on the right are torn, folded and partly collapsed.
observations.visual_evidence: Orange rust over the corrugated sheets; crumpled sheets and broken framing on the right.
observations.suggested_fix: Remove the collapsed roofing; the sheds are beyond simple repair.

observations.label: Power pole with transformer next to derelict sheds
observations.description: A power pole with a transformer stands close to the collapsed sheds. If the line is still live, it's a hazard for anyone clearing the site.
observations.visual_evidence: Wooden pole with a pole-mounted transformer and lines, a few metres from the sheds.
observations.suggested_fix: Ask the utility whether the service is live and have it disconnected before demolition or clearing.

frame_0009.jpg.scene: Ground-level view of a silo covered in graffiti; barn in the background.

observations.label: Graffiti showing trespass on the site
observations.description: The silo is covered in graffiti, which shows people are getting onto the site despite the dangerous structures.
observations.visual_evidence: Spray-painted tags on the lower silo wall.
observations.suggested_fix: Fence the site and post warning signs; the collapsing structures make trespass dangerous.

frame_0010.jpg.scene: Looking down past the open top of the brick silo toward the barn and sheds.

observations.label: Open top of roofless silo
observations.description: The brick silo has no roof; its open top collects rain and vines are growing over the rim, which loosens the brickwork.
observations.visual_evidence: Open circular brick rim with vines across it, dark interior.
observations.suggested_fix: Fence off a fall zone of at least the silo's height, keep everyone away, and get a structural engineer to decide on emergency bracing or controlled demolition.

frame_0012.jpg.scene: Barn gable end next to the silos.

observations.label: Hayloft door missing and roof collapse visible inside
observations.description: The hayloft door is gone, and through the opening you can see collapsed roof framing inside. Two small windows lower down are broken out.
observations.visual_evidence: Large dark opening at the top of the gable with broken timbers visible inside; two empty window frames below.
observations.suggested_fix: Board up the openings to keep people and weather out; don't enter until the structure is assessed.

frame_0013.jpg.scene: Inside the barn loft looking along the gambrel roof.

observations.label: Daylight through missing roof boards
observations.description: Inside the loft, daylight shows through large gaps where roof boards and sheets are missing. Rain is getting in and rotting the rafters.
observations.visual_evidence: Bright patches of sky between the rafters and a sunlit pattern on the floor.
observations.suggested_fix: Structural assessment of rafters for rot; re-roof only if the frame is sound.

observations.label: Loose metal sheet hanging from the rafters
observations.description: A loose metal roof sheet is hanging down from the rafters and could fall on anyone below.
observations.visual_evidence: Grey sheet hanging at an angle from the top-left rafters.
observations.suggested_fix: Nobody should enter; remove the sheet from a safe position during make-safe work.

frame_0014.jpg.scene: Inside the far end of the barn, looking into the sun.

observations.label: Roof collapsed at far end of barn
observations.description: At the far end of the barn the roof has collapsed: rafters are broken and the roof is open to the sky.
observations.visual_evidence: Broken rafters and boards hanging down, open sky and branches visible through the roof.
observations.extent: Last few bays of the barn
observations.suggested_fix: Treat the barn as unsafe; structural engineer to decide on demolition.

summary.summary: An abandoned farmstead with a gambrel barn, three stave silos with metal domes, a free-standing brick silo and several open-sided sheds. The buildings are past routine repair and several are actively collapsing. The barn roof has large holes, sagging bays and a collapsed far end ({{Barn roof partly collapsed}}, {{Roof collapsed at far end}}), with a loose metal sheet hanging inside ({{Loose metal sheet hanging}}). The roofless brick silo is leaning noticeably ({{Roofless brick silo leaning}}), and the sheds have collapsed with rusted roofing on the ground ({{Collapsed shed roofs}}, {{Collapsed shed roof lying}}). Graffiti and a parked car show that people are coming onto the site ({{Graffiti}}), and a power pole with a transformer stands next to the collapsed sheds ({{Power pole}}). The main risk is to people, not to the buildings: the priority is to keep everyone off the site and decide which structures to demolish.
key_risks: Collapse of the leaning brick silo onto anyone nearby ({{Roofless brick silo leaning}}).
Further roof collapse inside the barn and falling sheets ({{Barn roof partly collapsed}}, {{Roof collapsed at far end}}, {{Loose metal sheet hanging}}).
A possibly live electrical service next to demolition work ({{Power pole}}).
Loose sheets blowing off domes and sheds in high wind ({{Hole torn in silo dome}}, {{Loose metal sheets}}).
immediate_actions: Fence the whole farmstead and post danger signs; set a fall zone around the leaning silo ({{Graffiti}}, {{Roofless brick silo leaning}}).
Keep everyone out of the barn and away from the sheds ({{Barn roof partly collapsed}}, {{Collapsed shed roofs}}).
Ask the utility whether the service at the pole is live and have it disconnected ({{Power pole}}).
next_30_days: Structural engineer's assessment of every structure: stabilise, dismantle or demolish.
Collect loose metal sheets and secure or remove loose dome panels ({{Loose metal sheets}}, {{Hole torn in silo dome}}).
Board up the barn openings ({{Hayloft door}}).
next_90_days: Carry out the demolition or stabilisation plan, starting with the leaning silo and collapsed sheds.
If the stave silos are kept, clear the vines and recoat or replace the domes ({{Vines covering silos}}, {{Heavy rust on silo dome}}, {{Rusted silo dome}}).
